title: Marketing CRM
summary: A web and mobile CRM for a safety-equipment distributor: annual and monthly targets by branch, area, division and sales person, daily sales entry, requests (lead, enquiry offer, order, DC, sample), follow-ups, payment collection, SMS and reports.

slides.title: Dashboard - targets
slides.caption: Branch annual target with this month's share, area-wise targets for Madurai, Trichy, TTN and TVL by division, sales employee targets and the support team.

slides.title: Month start sheet
slides.caption: Type each sales person's target and opening outstanding; 80% commitment and 60% collection target are worked out live, with branch and grand totals.

slides.title: Daily entry - one sales person
slides.caption: Choose date, area and sales person: sales and collection (value, bills, customers), pending orders, enquiries, leads, samples / DC and outstanding.

slides.title: Order in billing format
slides.caption: Customer on the left, order number, date and reference on the right, product lines with live amounts and total.

slides.title: Enquiry offer
slides.caption: Printable offer with expiry date, generated from the enquiry; one click to send the enquiry SMS.

slides.title: Customer support pending
slides.caption: One sales person at a glance: sales, pending orders customer-wise with a reason, payment and open DC.

slides.title: Payment follow-up
slides.caption: Customer statement with invoice, PO reference, balance and due date; mail, SMS or record a direct follow-up.

slides.title: Reports
slides.caption: Rep-wise reports with Excel / CSV export, such as monthly target commitment (open or closed).

slides.title: SMS from a record
slides.caption: Payment-due SMS filled from the customer's open bills; templates for enquiry, order and payment.

slides.title: HRM - sales team
slides.caption: Manager, sales executives, support admin and sales coordinators per branch with area, age and target links.

slides.title: Customer master
slides.caption: Add customers one by one or upload the existing customer list from Excel.

slides.title: Works on mobile
slides.caption: The same CRM on a phone browser; a mobile app (Expo) uses the secure API.
